definitions.name: Spotify_monthly_listeners_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Spotify monthly listeners for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Monthly listeners are a reach proxy, not a volume metric.

definitions.name: Spotify_followers_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Spotify followers for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Follower counts are reach proxies.

definitions.name: Spotify_popularity_daily
definitions.definition: Spotify popularity index for an artist (0-100).
definitions.coverage_limitations: Popularity is an opaque Spotify-computed index.

definitions.name: YouTube_subscribers_daily
definitions.definition: Daily YouTube channel subscribers for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Subscriber counts are reach proxies.

definitions.name: YouTube_channel_views_daily
definitions.definition: Total YouTube channel views (cumulative counter from YouTube).
definitions.coverage_limitations: Cumulative counter — use net_change between dates for period volume.

definitions.name: YouTube_artist_daily_views
definitions.definition: Daily YouTube artist views from YouTube Charts / YouTube Music.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Available for artists tracked by YouTube Charts.

definitions.name: YouTube_artist_monthly_views
definitions.definition: Monthly YouTube artist views (rolling 28-day) from YouTube Charts.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Rolling monthly window, not calendar month.

definitions.name: Instagram_followers_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Instagram follower count for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Instagram metrics may have intermittent coverage.

definitions.name: TikTok_followers_daily
definitions.definition: Daily TikTok follower count for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: TikTok metrics may have intermittent coverage.

definitions.name: TikTok_likes_daily
definitions.definition: Daily TikTok total likes for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: TikTok metrics may have intermittent coverage.

definitions.name: Twitter_followers_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Twitter/X follower count for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Twitter metrics may have intermittent coverage.

definitions.name: Facebook_followers_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Facebook page followers for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Facebook metrics may have intermittent coverage.

definitions.name: Facebook_likes_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Facebook page likes for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Facebook metrics may have intermittent coverage.

definitions.name: Facebook_talks_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Facebook 'talking about' count for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Facebook metrics may have intermittent coverage.

definitions.name: Soundcloud_followers_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Soundcloud follower count for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Soundcloud metrics may have limited coverage.

definitions.name: Deezer_fans_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Deezer fan count for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Deezer is more prevalent in Francophone Africa.

definitions.name: Wikipedia_views_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Wikipedia page views for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Wikipedia view data may have intermittent coverage.

definitions.name: Bandsintown_followers_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Bandsintown follower/tracker count for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Bandsintown metrics may have limited coverage.

definitions.name: Melon_fans_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Melon fan count for an artist (Korean platform).
definitions.coverage_limitations: Melon is a Korean-market platform; limited relevance for most Nigerian artists.

definitions.name: Twitch_followers_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Twitch follower count for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Twitch data may be empty for artists without Twitch presence.

definitions.name: Line_likes_daily
definitions.definition: Daily Line Music artist likes (Japanese platform).
definitions.coverage_limitations: Line Music is a Japanese-market platform; limited relevance for most Nigerian artists.

definitions.name: Where_People_Listen
definitions.definition: City-level listener share distribution for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Only Nigerian cities observed in the provider response should be emitted.
definitions.geo_limitations: Acts as a Nigeria-specific proxy for audience distribution.
definitions.fallback_logic: No fallback. If city-level Nigerian data is absent, record a limitation.

definitions.name: Shazam_chart_position_daily
definitions.definition: Shazam chart position for an artist.
definitions.coverage_limitations: Chart appearances are intermittent.
definitions.geo_limitations: May include country context from response payload.

denied_endpoints.note: Track-level Spotify stream counts require higher-tier plan.
Track-level YouTube view counts require higher-tier plan. Use YouTube_artist_daily_views instead.
Track-level Pandora streams require higher-tier plan.
Track-level Apple Music stats require higher-tier plan.
Track-level TikTok data requires higher-tier plan.
Track playlist appearances require higher-tier plan.
